thread:
emily: Noticed a nasty regression on canary EU: sparklines and metric rows stall ~2-3s on first open after login. Happening on large orgs.

ryan: which bundle / page? any console errors?

emily: metrics > timeseries view. console shows repeated module parse for `route-assets~metrics` and `telemetry-client` twice. network shows prefetch for multiple route assets immediately after auth.

tony: we shipped routeAssetPrefetch feature last night to reduce navigation jank by prefetching per-route chunks. maybe it's too eager and causing parse storms.

nina: hmm prefetch should be idle-only. did we gate on requestIdleCallback?

ryan: config in rollout: `routeAssetPrefetch: "immediate"` for canary to test. that will fetch on auth success synchronously. bad for cold tabs.

emily: stack sample:
```
0.0s: hydrate
0.1s: auth callback
0.11s: prefetch route-assets(metrics).js (240KB)
0.12s: prefetch route-assets/metrics-vendor.js (480KB)
0.13s: parse vendor (450ms)
0.58s: parse telemetry-client (370ms)
1.0s: initialize charts -> blocked until parse complete
```

tony: oof, that vendor parse is killing LCP. Also telemetry-client got pulled into vendor in last webpack bump, which explains duplicate parsing.

nina: two quick mitigations: 1) flip canary flag to `idle` so prefetch uses requestIdleCallback 2) ensure telemetry-client is outside vendor (separate chunk) or lazy import in worker.

ryan: agreed. can we patch the flag quickly?

deploy-bot: feature-toggle console:routeAssetPrefetch canary (eu) changing from "immediate" -> "idle" queued by ryan at 2025-12-03T14:02:10Z

emily: pushed a small PR to toggle in config service: https://github.com/redwood-inference/config-service/pull/812 (1-line). Also opened an issue to revisit bundling: split telemetry-client out of vendor.

tony: i'll throw up an emergency CDN-cache-bust plan in case the toggle needs rollback. but switching to idle should reduce main-thread spikes.

deploy-bot: feature-toggle console:routeAssetPrefetch canary (eu) updated at 2025-12-03T14:05:50Z

emily: after toggle replay looks better locally - LCP improved ~1.7s on cold. will monitor canary dashboards.

nina: followups: 1) add unit test that asserts prefetch only runs during idle window in simulated env 2) add e2e to simulate auth+open with slow CPU to catch parse storms 3) revisit bundler split for telemetry-client and mark it chunked behind a lazy import.

ryan: also add a dashboard alert for repeated module parse rate per session (new metric) so we catch this before rollout.

tony: filed bundler ticket: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/1445 - plan: move telemetry-client -> async chunk + worker shim.

emily: thanks team. tagging @product in the ticket for awareness since prefetch change was product-driven.

ryan: good catch, @emily. :thumbsup:
